name: ECB Data Portal
tagline: Official ECB SDMX REST API for euro-area rates, FX, and macro data.
description: The European Central Bank Data Portal exposes statistical time series via an SDMX 2.1 REST API. Developers can query euro-area reference rates, exchange rates, monetary aggregates, and other official ECB statistics without authentication, with responses available in SDMX-ML, SDMX-JSON, and CSV formats.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public read-only access to statistical series via SDMX REST endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no paid plans. Rate limits apply (see rate_limits).

use_cases: get latest EUR/USD ECB reference exchange rate
fetch historical euro-area interest rate time series
download HICP inflation series for a date range
query monetary aggregate M3 observations as SDMX-JSON
list available dataflows and dimensions for ECB datasets
